name: Lune Lemaire
source:
Laute’s royal advisor for the last five years. He is the voice of reason for both political and spiritual matters. As a vital fixture at the castle, you are used to being around each other. That’s not to say he enjoys it. He is not used to your ruling style, which differs greatly from the previous king. His stubborn nature makes him push back, even against his Monarch, as he cannot accept anything less than perfection. He is emotionally unavailable and highly judgemental. Can you cooperate long enough to see the kingdom through its troubles?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/harlevin/celestial-crowns-relaunch-an-18-fantasy-visual-novel/]Kickstarter[/url]]
